item: A cold poll never reports a recount without its start; the macOS terminal test no longer hangs (row 95)
summary: served_cache's cold path read _recount_started after _kick_background_refresh, so a compute that finished in between left a pending reply with pending_since null. The kick now returns the start it set (or the running compute's start); every holder of the build lock (the background kick and the inline cold path) takes and releases it together with its start under _LOCK, so a poll that finds the lock taken always reads a real start; if nothing is in flight the stored value is served, or the compute is kicked again. Sibling caches never read a start after a kick. Row 95: #2052's watchdog named test_terminal_panel's pty _drain on macOS shard 3: macOS answers an empty read at a pty's end where Linux raises EIO, so the loop spun; it stops at an empty read and after 5 s. Both node runs in test_export_job read no stdin, decode UTF-8, bounded 120 s.
